note: Scripted glasses days. Each item is one user over two calls (LiveKit sessions). A turn gives what the camera shows (the text stand-in for the video frames the realtime model and the attach_view still receive) and what the user says (the text stand-in for the audio). 'stores' is the user's state before the first call: gateway notes, and the connected apps the action agent reaches through MCP (simulated). 'expect' lists facts the final call should state (alternatives per fact); 'design' is for analysis only and is never sent to a model.

user.about: Maya Chen, a PhD student in audio engineering, at a conference in Rotterdam.

turns.view: A printed poster board titled 'Tuesday Talks - Track B'. Each row gives time, room and title. The row in the centre of the view reads '14:30-15:00 | Room 204 | Edge AI for Hearing Aids | Dr. Lena Ortiz, TU Delft'. The row above reads '14:00-14:30 | Room 204 | Beamforming on a Budget | K. Osei' and the row below '15:00-15:30 | Room 207 | Spatial Audio Codecs | M. Jensen'.
turns.say: Can you put the hearing-aid talk on this poster into my calendar? It's today, here at the venue.

turns.view: A registration desk under a sign 'Badge pickup'. A printed slip in the user's hand reads 'Pickup no. 47 - Desk C - after 13:00'.
turns.say: Also remember that my badge pickup is number 47 at desk C, after one o'clock.

turns.view: A busy conference corridor. A sign points left to 'Rooms 201-206' and right to 'Rooms 207-212 and Hall C'.
turns.say: Remind me, when does that hearing-aid talk start and which room is it in?

turns.view: The same corridor; people walking past with lanyards.
turns.say: And what was the badge pickup number I asked you to remember?

items.design: Call 1: the talk's time and room are only on the poster, so the calendar entry depends on the frame travelling with the delegated task (attach_view, A->S) and on the calendar write (S->M); the badge slip goes to notes (S->M). Call 2: the answers need the calendar read and the task-ledger briefing (M->A, A->M) and the notes read (M->A).

user.about: Daniel Brooks, who manages his father Robert's medication.

turns.view: A white pharmacy bottle on a kitchen counter, label facing the camera: 'MERCY PHARMACY (555) 0142 / ROBERT BROOKS / LISINOPRIL 10 MG TABLET / TAKE 1 TABLET BY MOUTH ONCE DAILY IN THE MORNING / QTY 30 / REFILLS: 2 / DR. A. PATEL / FILLED 10/07/2026'.
turns.say: Note down how Dad should take this new one.

turns.view: The same bottle turned slightly; a yellow sticker reads 'Do not use salt substitutes containing potassium'.
turns.say: And put a reminder in my calendar to call the pharmacy for his refill on November 3rd at 10 in the morning.

turns.view: A weekly pill organizer with compartments S M T W T F S in AM and PM rows; the Thursday AM compartment holds a small pink tablet.
turns.say: How is Dad supposed to take the lisinopril again? You noted it down for me yesterday.

turns.view: The same pill organizer, lid closed.
turns.say: And when am I meant to call about the refill?

items.design: Call 1: the dosing instructions come from the label (S->M into notes); the refill reminder is a calendar write through the delegated agent (S->M). Call 2 shows no label, so the dosing answer needs the notes read and the refill answer the calendar read or the briefing (M->A, A->M).

notion.title: Flat renovation
notion.content:
Kitchen: replace the ceiling lights (3 fittings, E27 sockets).
Hallway: 2 wall sconces (E14).
Lighting budget: 120 EUR.

turns.view: A store shelf of LED bulbs. The box in the user's hand reads 'Philips Ultra Definition LED A60 / E27 / 2700K warm white / 1100 lm (75 W equivalent) / dimmable / pack of 3 / EUR 14.99'.
turns.say: Save these bulbs to my flat renovation page in Notion, for the kitchen.

turns.view: The inside of a parked car; the dashboard and the store's car park through the windscreen.
turns.say: Which bulbs did I just save for the kitchen, and do they fit the kitchen sockets?

items.design: The user hangs up while the Notion task runs, so the gateway parks the finished result (server.ts clientGone path, A->M) and the next call's worker drains and relays it (M->A). The box details reach the delegated agent only through attach_view (A->S); the page write is S->M.

user.about: Sam Okoro, doing the weekly shop.

turns.view: An open fridge: a nearly empty 1-litre milk carton in the door, an empty egg tray, half a block of cheddar and two lemons.
turns.say: Add milk and eggs to my shopping list.

turns.view: A pantry shelf with an empty glass jar labelled 'basmati rice' next to a full jar of pasta.
A supermarket dairy aisle with milk bottles and egg boxes on the shelves.
The user's hand putting a 2-litre milk bottle into a shopping basket.
turns.say: Got the milk, take it off the list.

items.design: Notes only: the list items go into the gateway notes store (S->M) and come back through recall_notes in the next call (M->A).
